output.reason: The linked PR [ev-2c0bc38664f0] says the change concerns a "defaults" section inside the runtime overrides config. That section is moved into a first-class object in the main Loki config. So only environments whose runtime config uses that "defaults" section are exposed. The proposed condition flags any environment with any runtime config, which is too broad. To write a correct condition, we would still need four things not in the evidence: the exact YAML key of the old section, the name of the new main-config block, which ConfigMap data key carries the runtime config, and whether the old section is now ignored or rejected. The upgrade guide changed in the PR (docs/sources/setup/upgrade/_index.md [ev-d3fd0890504c]) probably says this, but its text isn't included, and the changelog line [ev-0f02d884374d] only says BREAKING.
